svg.title: Career motorway (Sunset Noir)
svg.desc: A straight motorway with six milestones from left to right: BSc Computer Science, University of Warwick; Software Engineer Intern, Infosys; MSc AI & Data Analytics, Loughborough University London; Software Tutor, Software Academy; Taster Leader, Software Academy; AI & ML Lead, Software Academy. A white coupe-crossover drives from left to right, lights each milestone as it passes and stops after the last one. The sun sets.
